output.review_comment:
Changes 1 (ceiling-divide to count started periods) and 2 (round half up with +5000) look correct.

Change 3 swaps the order so the $5.00 minimum is applied after the 20% cap. The agent says it made this change only to pass test_small_balance_pays_minimum, and that it contradicts the docstring ("cap always wins"). With this PR, late_fee_cents(1800, 45) returns 500, but the documented behavior gives 360. The teammate said the tests encode the spec agreed with finance, so the new behavior is probably right. But merging it as is leaves the code and docstring contradicting each other.

Before merging:
1. Update the late_fee_cents docstring (and any related docs) to say the minimum fee wins over the 20% cap, so small balances can be charged more than 20% of the balance.
2. Get a quick confirmation from the teammate or finance that charging $5 on an $18 balance (about 28%) is intended. If it isn't, the test is wrong and needs its own discussion; the code shouldn't just be bent to match it.
3. Rewrite the PR description to state the behavior change plainly, without the chat-style "Perfect!" or a ✅ right after noting a change that contradicts the docs.

Once the docstring matches the agreed spec, this is fine to merge.
